digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria routing and G7 reviewer
propositions: G7 routing entry default_posture is set to 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95, causing G7 to never block despite 22 correct findings at priority >= 0.85 in 348 historical findings
Unresolvable parent tickets emit findings instead of abstaining with coverage, producing false positives (observed on ticket 18f9)
Identical contradictions from the same parent clause generate duplicate findings that stack instead of deduplicating to one finding with combined evidence (ticket 76d2 had 3 findings for one parent)

The rubric lacks explicit guidance distinguishing floor-kind divergences (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site) from incomplete_enumeration, leading to cosmetic divergences reaching the blocking threshold
Closed parent contracts are checked against their runtime state rather than final state, and sibling handoffs are incorrectly flagged as leaf violations

G7 blocking must be enabled at 0.85 threshold with routing default_posture 'blocking', rubric guidance added for abstain-on-unresolvable, closed-parent final-state handling, one-finding-per-clause dedup, and floor-kind scoping
